senses.gloss: ch. same, to call, name, invite; to read.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:34">Targ. Gen. XXIX, 34</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 3:6">Targ. I Sam. III, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:19">Targ. Gen. II, 19</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 17:19">Targ. Deut. XVII, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 6:1">Targ. Esth. VI, 1</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Megillah 18b:9">Meg. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>דקָרוּ ליה וכ׳</he> when they call him (in his sleep), and he answers.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:2">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:4">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>קְרוּן בשכונתיה וכ׳</he> they called (begging for alms) in the neighborhood &c.

Ber. 13ᵇ מִקְרָא הוא דלא לִיקְרֵי וכ׳ one is not permitted to read the Sh’mʿa (while lying on one’s back), but &c.; מקרא … נמי אסיר to read is forbidden even when turning sideways. Ib. 11ᵇ כתיב רע וקְרִינָן הכל it is written (Is. XLV, 7) ‘and creates evil’, and we read (in the morning prayers) ‘all’! Pes. 3ᵃ קָרוּ נגהי, v. נָגְהָא.
<cite ref="Pesachim 3a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>קַרְיֵיה … לנהורא וכ׳</he> the Lord called the light and appointed it &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:3">Gen. R. s. 40</cite> <he>הוה קָרֵי עליהין נותן וכ׳</he> applied to them the verse (<cite ref="Isaiah 40:29">Is. XL, 29</cite>), he giveth &c.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 5b:13">M. Kat. 5ᵇ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>ק׳ עליה וכ׳</he> applied to him the verse &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 17a">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>למאן דקרי ותני וכ׳</he> (at the funeral) of one that read the Bible and studied Mishnah, but of one that taught others &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 152b:11">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>גלית … נביאי לא קְרֵית</he> thou showest that thou hast not even read the Prophets (v. infra). Y. Meg. III, 74ᵇ bot. <he>אילין … מאי דיִקְרִינָן וכ׳</he> as to the curses (v. <cite ref="A03248"><he>אֲרַר</he></cite>), dare one person read them and recite the benediction before and after them? <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 47:3">Ex. R. s. 47</cite> <he>למדו … ודקָרִין בלילה</he> learn the Torah from such teachers as get up early and study while it is yet night, v. <cite ref="A01337"><he>אִימְּטִין</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—
Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵃ bot., a. e. קְרָאיֵי they recite.—Part. pass. קְרִי, קְרִיא; pl. קְרִיָּין the Massoretic reading, opp. כתיב.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 9:8">Treat. Sof’rim ch. IX, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 37b:10">Ned. 37ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01357"><he>כְּתִיב</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (Pa. קָרֵי) to make read, to teach (the Scriptures). Sabb. l. c. דקָרְיָיךְ קהלת לא אַקְרְיָיךְ משלי (Ms. M. דאַקְרְיָיךְ) he that taught thee Koheleth (Ecclesiastes) failed to teach thee Mishlé (Proverbs); Yalk. Gen. 33; Yalk. Ez. 376 דאקרייך.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 9a:9">Yeb. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>מדמַקְרֵי ליה וכ׳</he> as R. J. taught his son the interpretation of &c.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:14:1">Koh. R. to III, 14</cite> <he>מקרתה</he>, read: <he>מקרי ליה</he>, v. <cite ref="S02051"><he>קַרְיָיא</he></cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M02459"><he>מַקְרֵי</he></cite>.—[Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Genesis 2:19">B’resh. 2</cite> <he>ולקרוייה</he>, read: <he>וליַקּוּרֵיה</he>.]
